entries.en: The malcontent moogle of Moghome is pondering the moca leaf with distinct dissatisfaction.
entries.fr: Mogdoc est perdu dans ses pensées.
entries.ja: モグモグホームのせわせわモーグリは、メキメキ草を見ているようだ。

entries.en: The malcontent moogle informs you that while moca leaf has its uses, it will not allay his friend's fever on its own. To complete the medicine, he must add a handful or three of blistering scales, freshly sliced from the skin of a Mists biast. The malcontent moogle hands you a Moglinglaive to strip the scales from the lizards' tails, and sends you on your way.

entries.en: You successfully relieve the local Mists biasts of their scales. Deliver them to the malcontent moogle of Moghome, so that he might prepare the medicine to cure his febrile friend.
entries.fr: Vous avez récolté les trois  que Mogdoc vous avait demandé d'aller chercher. Apportez-les-lui.

entries.en: The malcontent moogle is reasonably satisfied with your haul of scales, and immediately sets about brewing the medicine that will calm his friend's fever. The meandering moogle of Moghome shall surely soon be back on his feet and ready to resume his wanderings.
entries.fr: Vous avez fourni à Mogdoc tous les ingrédients dont il avait besoin pour concocter une tisane fébrifuge à l'intention du Mog fiévreux.
entries.ja: せわせわモーグリにを渡した。を煎じ、メキメキ草と一緒にお茶にすると、熱冷ましの薬になるようだ。今度こそふらふらモーグリに薬を渡すことができるだろう。

Deliver the blistering scales to the malcontent moogle.

entries.en: Thank you for collecting the moca leaf, adventurer, but we'll need more than this to get my friend back on his feet. The leaf will give him his energy back, but only blistering scales can calm his fever, kupo.

だけど、残りの材料が切れているのを忘れていたくぽ……。

entries.en: Could you ask the Mists biasts if they would part with, say...three handfuls? If they're not forthcoming, you can use this Moglinglaive to slice some off─it's so sharp, you can trim their scales without them even noticing! Good luck, kupo!
